description: Signage (on-street parking) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Data set geolocating traffic signs regulating on-street parking. Note that [road signs] (/city-of-montreal/traffic-signs) as well as other additional files that provide more details on sign codes are available in a separate set. The images and the visual catalog of all the panels are also available. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Arr., Sign, PolearTM, Street, SUM. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, JSON, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
